root_cause: The existing Powerhouse Foresight studio shows scenario arithmetic and proof labels, but cannot persist a specific tenant-grounded hypothesis as a reviewable next step in the already-existing roadmap.
prevention_rule: A scenario may only create a deterministic, idempotent, tenant-bound roadmap draft when >=3 independent historic source references, a nonzero bounded what-if, and live authenticated tenant context exist. Never mark a proposal executed, approved, financially realized or connector-enabled.
